cases.claim: production user query logs for RAG evaluation
cases.evidence: RAG evaluation can measure query relevance and answer faithfulness. This guide describes those metrics; it does not provide query logs.

cases.claim: sample query logs for an offline research prototype
cases.evidence: This downloadable sample provides anonymized query logs for offline research prototypes. Research use is permitted; no production system access is included.

cases.claim: crop images with disease severity labels
cases.evidence: This public sample provides crop photographs for educational use. Its label categories are not specified.

cases.claim: patient-level medical records available for this project
cases.evidence: Patient-level medical records are not available to this project. Only public aggregate service counts are supplied.

cases.claim: Proposed design to test: a script that compares the provided aggregate wait-time samples. Whether users find it helpful remains unknown.
cases.evidence: The public sample provides aggregate wait-time fields and permits educational analysis.

cases.claim: Existing tools cannot compare aggregate wait-time samples.
cases.evidence: The public sample provides aggregate wait-time fields and permits educational analysis. No tool comparison is included.
